28.desc:
Trop Headz brings together Tropical Treatz and Headshot for a layered profile that moves from bright island fruit into deeper earthy sweetness. Tropical Treatz contributes juicy notes of ripe mango, pineapple candy, citrus zest, and a creamy tropical-dessert character, while Headshot adds honey-like sweetness, earthy depth, pine, and subtle herbal freshness. The result is a fruit-forward cultivar pairing with a sweet citrus core and a grounded, resinous finish. Grown by Garden Greens, the profile is backed by a terpene lineup led by ß-caryophyllene and limonene, with linalool, humulene, and myrcene adding further aromatic complexity.

Presented as a SUN Live Resin Badder, Trop Headz delivers the blends terpene-rich character in a concentrate format built to showcase its bold aroma and layered flavor. Like all SUN products, it is 100% cannabis with nothing added.

From its tropical candy brightness to its earthy, pine-kissed finish, Trop Headz is a carefully crafted live resin badder that puts the quality of the starting material and its naturally expressive cannabis profile front and center.

29.desc:
A bold combination of Blue Limeade and Black Maple live resin, Blue Blizzard presents a complex sensory experience that moves from vibrant tropical citrus and floral notes into deeper layers of earth, sweet grape, and sugary richness.

SUN approaches concentrates with an emphasis on potency, flavor, consistency, and terpene expression. Rather than simply pursuing high cannabinoid numbers, premium live resin is about capturing a more complete representation of the plant—its aromatic compounds, nuanced flavors, and distinctive genetic character. Exceptional potency. Layered terpene expression. A sophisticated fusion of fruit-forward brightness and deep, dessert-like richness.

Blue Limeade contributes to a character commonly associated with relaxed, euphoric, and happy effects, while Black Maple is known for its euphoric and deeply relaxing profile. Together, these strain notes suggest a balanced experience that begins with uplifting euphoria before settling into a more soothing, grounded character.

284.desc: Blue Candy arrived on the West Coast during the 2010s dessert-strain boom, when breeders were chasing the sweet spot between DJ Short's legendary Blueberry line and the new candy-terpene wave. Accounts differ on the exact cross — some growers swear by a Blue Dream × Candy Kush lineage, others point to Blueberry × Cotton Candy Kush — but every cut carries that unmistakable collision of ripe berry and spun sugar. The buds finish as medium spears, dense but not rock-hard, draped in a silver-white trichome sheen with copper pistils curling through; cool nights paint the calyx tips violet and inky blue. Crack a jar and you get blueberry jam and cotton-candy sweetness up front, then lemon-lime zest and a piney edge, finishing with a whisper of vanilla and brown sugar on the exhale. The high opens with a bright, talkative lift that sharpens focus and sparks conversation, then settles into a calm, contented body hum without locking you to the couch. Made for a late-afternoon creative session.
